Put Professor Pepe on your website

One script tag gives your visitors the Pepecoin community assistant: chat, memes, rare pepes, community art and social-post drafting. Nothing to install, nothing to host — it runs from here.

Floating chat button

Paste this just before </body>. A Pepe button appears in the bottom-right corner; clicking it opens the chat. Try it — the button on this page is exactly that.

Inline, inside your page

Give it a container and it fills that instead of floating:

Options

All go on the script tag as data- attributes and are optional.

AttributeValuesWhat it does
data-modefloating (default), inlineFloating button, or fill a container
data-targetCSS selectorInline only: the container (default #professor-pepe)
data-heightpixelsInline only: height of the chat (default 600)
data-positionright (default), leftFloating only: which corner
data-colorany CSS colourLauncher button colour
data-opentrueFloating only: start with the chat open

From your own scripts: ProfessorPepe.open(), ProfessorPepe.close(), ProfessorPepe.toggle().

Good to know

  • The chat runs in an iframe from this domain. It cannot read your page, and it cannot break your page's styles.
  • Works on phones: the floating panel goes full-screen below 480px.
  • Every picture is served with the Professor Pepe watermark; your visitors can save the original from the download buttons.
